limits: Stage 1 tests are not a valid ecological comparison population; taxon/site/season/availability and individual redeployments are not screened.
No conditional individual movement identity G or resource/physical co-use P has been estimated.
Sensor term GPS is derived from individual event rows when sensor-type present; otherwise needs separate original sensor validation.
Source coordinates, tag/animal IDs and animal-day records were not stored in this public result.
Any status PASS is provisional only and cannot be called biologically eligible until population-level and precision gates pass.
